items.title: The composition of two quasi-affine morphisms is quasi-affine

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the composite of two quasi-affine morphisms is quasi-affine (statement lines 2497-2500). The counted proof is short but not a citation: it represents the preimage under the second morphism as a quasi-compact open subscheme of a relative spectrum, then represents the further preimage under the first morphism inside a relative spectrum over that, pushes the sheaf of algebras forward along the witnessing open immersion, and reads the resulting fibre square with affine upper right corner as the required presentation of the preimage of an affine open under the composite (proof lines 2502-2531). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span and its inputs are the relative spectrum formalism and quasi-coherence of pushforwards.
